content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for a template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the DIBAL-H reduction: carbon-oxygen bond broken (ester to aldehyde) and another carbon-oxygen bond order changes from double to single (forming aliphatic hydroxyl). The forward reaction: ester -> aldehyde + alcohol? Actually DIBAL reduces ester to aldehyde, not breaking the C-O bond of the carbonyl? It reduces the carbonyl C=O to C=O (aldehyde) and the other C-O bond (the alkoxy) is broken, giving an alcohol (the alkoxy becomes alcohol). So functional groups broken: carboxylic ester (the C-O bond to alkoxy). Formed: aldehyde and aliphatic hydroxyl (the alkoxy becomes alcohol). So broken: carboxylic esters. Formed: aldehydes, aliphatic hydroxyls. Let's search with both formed groups.
